violation_type.title: Allow Parents to Visit Child-care Home Anytime During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.207(5))
violation_type.short_title: Allow Parents to Visit Child-care Home Anytime During Hours of Operation
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined that a parent did not have access to the home when their child was present during the hours of operation.

finding_variants.text: It was determined that a parent did not have access to the home when their child was present during the hours of operation.
During the investigation, it was made aware the operation has "at-door policy" that has parents drop off and pick up at the door.
During the investigation it was found that parents are not allowed inside the home.
